name: Dormant-Client Follow-Up

parameters.content:
## Dormant-Client Follow-Up

### How it works

1. The workflow runs two daily scheduled checks: one for dormant client matters and one for renewal dates.
2. It fetches open matters from Clio and identifies those that have become dormant to send alert emails.
3. It reads renewal dates from a Google Sheets ledger and filters those needing renewal reminders.
4. The workflow builds and logs email alerts for dormancy and renewal reminders for compliance auditing.
5. Finally, it sends the respective emails to notify the appropriate parties.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure Clio API credentials and set the CLIO_BASE_URL environment variable.
- [ ] Connect to Google Sheets with correct spreadsheet and sheet permissions to read renewal data.
- [ ] Set up email sending credentials for the emailSend nodes to send alerts.
- [ ] Ensure the sub-workflows for logging compliance audits are accessible and have correct permissions.

### Customization

Customize the dormancy criteria and reminder timing in the code nodes to fit business rules and client engagement policies.

## Dormant matters detection

Scheduled trigger fetches open matters from Clio, splits records, checks dormancy, filters relevant matters, builds alert emails, logs audit entries, and sends dormant matter notifications.

## Renewal date reminders

Scheduled trigger reads renewal dates from Google Sheets, checks which reminders are needed, filters them, builds renewal reminder emails, logs compliance audits, and sends renewal reminder emails.

nodes.name: Every Morning at 8am Check Dormant Matters
nodes.notes: Runs daily, 8am by default — adjust the cron expression if a different time suits.

nodes.name: Fetch Open Matters from Clio API
nodes.notes: Pulls every currently Open matter. Firms with over 200 open matters will need pagination added (not built here — most solo/small firms won't hit this).

nodes.name: Split Out Matter Records
nodes.notes: Breaks the matters list into one item per matter.

nodes.name: Check If Matter Is Dormant
nodes.notes: DORMANT_THRESHOLD_DAYS controls both the dormancy line and the re-flagging cooldown — a still-dormant matter surfaces again after that many more days, not every single day.

nodes.name: Filter Matters Needing Dormancy Alert
nodes.notes: Most days this drops every matter — that is normal, it only keeps matters that just crossed the dormancy line or are off cooldown after re-flagging.

nodes.name: Build Dormant Matter Alert Email
nodes.notes: The soft LegalContext mention here is the entire point of this template — it's a teaser, not a hard sell, and only ever goes to the firm, never the client.

nodes.name: Log Dormant Alert for Compliance Audit
nodes.notes: Fire-and-forget audit logging only — this is an internal firm nudge, not a client communication, so the guardrail's approval result is deliberately ignored, same pattern used throughout this catalog.

nodes.name: Send Dormant Matter Alert Email
nodes.notes: Reaches back to 'Build Dormant Matter Alert Email' by name, not $json, since the guardrail call in between replaces $json with its own response.

nodes.name: Every Morning at 8am Check Renewal Dates
nodes.notes: Runs daily, same time as the dormancy check by default — adjust independently if you'd rather stagger them.

nodes.name: Read Renewal Dates from Sheet
nodes.notes: Reads the manually-maintained sheet of key recurring dates. Columns: matter_ref, client_name, description, renewal_date, attorney_email.

nodes.name: Check If Renewal Reminder Needed
nodes.notes: RENEWAL_REMINDER_DAYS controls how far ahead the first reminder fires — defaults to 30 days.

nodes.name: Filter Renewals Needing Reminder
nodes.notes: Only rows inside the reminder window (or overdue) survive — most days this finds nothing to send.

nodes.name: Build Renewal Reminder Email
nodes.notes: Overdue renewals get an OVERDUE prefix and fire daily; upcoming ones get a plain heads-up and fire once per tier.

nodes.name: Log Renewal Reminder for Compliance Audit
nodes.notes: Fire-and-forget audit logging only — internal firm reminder, not a client communication.

nodes.name: Send Renewal Reminder Email
nodes.notes: Reaches back to 'Build Renewal Reminder Email' by name, not $json, since the guardrail call in between replaces $json with its own response.

main.node: Log Renewal Reminder for Compliance Audit
Log Dormant Alert for Compliance Audit

description: Runs on two independent daily schedules. Dormant matter detection: scans every Open Clio matter, flags any not updated in DORMANT_THRESHOLD_DAYS, and nudges the responsible attorney to check in -- with a soft LegalContext Dormant Follow-Up teaser, since that's this template's upsell path. Renewal reminders (separate): re-reads a manually-maintained Google Sheet of recurring dates (trademark renewals, filings, etc.) and alerts before each one, then daily once overdue. Never contacts the client directly -- always alerts the firm. Replaces LegalContext's own tracking as a free teaser, surfacing hidden revenue and forgotten deadlines sitting in a quiet client list.
